hairstyles.name: Textured Crop
hairstyles.description: A short, textured haircut with a slightly longer top and cropped sides, styled with natural texture for a modern, effortless look.

hairstyles.name: French Crop
hairstyles.description: A clean, short crop with a defined fringe and tight sides, offering a sharp and low-maintenance silhouette.

hairstyles.name: Modern Mod Cut
hairstyles.description: A textured fringe paired with tapered sides, blending retro mod styling with a contemporary finish.

hairstyles.name: Messy Fringe
hairstyles.description: A relaxed, tousled fringe with natural movement, ideal for a casual and low-effort everyday style.

hairstyles.name: Curtains
hairstyles.description: Center-parted, longer strands framing the face on both sides, reminiscent of late-90s styling.

hairstyles.name: Middle Part
hairstyles.description: Hair evenly split down the center, worn medium length for a sleek, symmetrical look.

hairstyles.name: Two Block
hairstyles.description: A Korean-style cut with dramatically shorter sides and back beneath a longer, voluminous top.

hairstyles.name: Undercut
hairstyles.description: Sharply shaved or cropped sides beneath longer top hair, creating high contrast and a bold silhouette.

hairstyles.name: Buzz Cut
hairstyles.description: Uniformly short hair clipped close to the scalp across the entire head, the ultimate low-maintenance option.

hairstyles.name: Crew Cut
hairstyles.description: A short, classic cut with slightly more length on top than a buzz cut, tapered neatly at the sides.

hairstyles.name: Quiff
hairstyles.description: Voluminous top hair swept upward and back, tapered shorter on the sides for a polished, dynamic look.

hairstyles.name: Slick Back
hairstyles.description: All hair combed straight back from the forehead using product for a sleek, glossy finish.

hairstyles.name: Taper Fade
hairstyles.description: A gradual fade from longer hair on top to closely shaved sides, blending seamlessly down the hairline.

hairstyles.name: Low Fade
hairstyles.description: A subtle fade that starts low near the ears, keeping more length and a softer transition than a high fade.

hairstyles.name: Mid Fade
hairstyles.description: A versatile fade starting midway up the sides, balancing a clean look with styling flexibility on top.
